title: In-app AI assistant chat interface (React)
summary: Embed a production-grade chat and agent UI in a React application: streaming messages, tool calls, attachments and formatted assistant output. Evaluate the assistant-ui suite both as direct imports and as the transitive dependency tree they bring in.
constraints: Permissive license across the full dependency tree
No install scripts in the dependency tree
No telemetry or network calls unless explicitly configured
notes: @assistant-ui/react is the only package intended for direct import; core, tap and store are transitive. @assistant-ui/store was added to this review because it is a required peer of core and react and was missing from the original four. Third-party transitive packages (radix-ui, zod, zustand, react-markdown) are covered by tree-level checks rather than individual reviews.
